doc.title: Ralph LaLama interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, May 23, 2010

title: Goals and thirty-five years in New York
summary: He has no long-term goals; career has only gotten better.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: Good point. Do you have any short or long term goals?

Oh I’m never good at that, I’m serious. My wife always asks me, I say no. I just, I’m always thinking ahead. That’s my short term and my long term. As I grow I say what’s the next step? One thing I have to say about myself, I’ve been living in New York for thirty-five years and I never went backwards. You know what I mean? I mean either financially or career-wise, I mean God, I never really got sick or something, then you’d go backwards. But it’s always, everything got better. Yeah. I’d have to say that.
